messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Showcasing my smiles and cheering my lungs out (: Good fight on the mats!

output.original_text: Showcasing my smiles and cheering my lungs out (: Good fight on the mats!
output.joy: Beaming with joy and cheering my heart out! What an incredible fight on the mats!
output.sadness: Trying to smile through it, but I can barely cheer. It was a tough fight on the mats.
output.fear: Trying to smile while my heart races, hoping for the best on the mats. That fight was intense!
output.anger: Frustrated but still showing my teeth and cheering, that fight on the mats was infuriating!
output.surprise: I can't believe my smiles while cheering so hard! That fight on the mats was unexpectedly amazing!
output.disgust: Really forcing a smile while trying to cheer properly. That fight on the mats was just messy!
